prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Carmen, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Carmen thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "Starting next month the neighborhood council will fine anyone who leaves their bins on the sidewalk after 8am."
text: Can you believe they’re actually going to fine us for our bins now? Old Mr. Henderson said the council is even installing a new surveillance camera on Elm Street just to catch people who leave them out past 8am!
